hook.en: MEASAT satellites hover over the same spot above Malaysia all day, beaming TV and internet to your home. Why don't they fall down — and why don't they drift away?
hook.bm: Satelit MEASAT kelihatan pegun di atas Malaysia sepanjang hari, memancarkan TV dan internet ke rumah anda. Mengapa ia tidak jatuh — dan mengapa ia tidak hanyut?

bigIdeas.en: Every mass attracts every other mass: F = Gm₁m₂/r².
bigIdeas.bm: Setiap jisim menarik jisim lain: F = Gm₁m₂/r².

bigIdeas.en: Double the distance → the force falls to a quarter (inverse-square law).
bigIdeas.bm: Gandakan jarak → daya menjadi suku (hukum songsang kuasa dua).

bigIdeas.en: Gravity provides the centripetal force that keeps planets and satellites in orbit.
bigIdeas.bm: Graviti membekalkan daya memusat yang mengekalkan planet dan satelit dalam orbit.

bigIdeas.en: Kepler's laws: elliptical orbits, equal areas in equal times, and T² ∝ r³.
bigIdeas.bm: Hukum Kepler: orbit elips, luas sama dalam masa sama, dan T² ∝ r³.

bigIdeas.en: Orbital speed v = √(GM/r): higher satellites move more slowly.
bigIdeas.bm: Laju orbit v = √(GM/r): satelit lebih tinggi bergerak lebih perlahan.

definition.en: The attractive force between any two masses.
definition.bm: Daya tarikan antara mana-mana dua jisim.

definition.en: Force towards the centre that keeps an object moving in a circle.
definition.bm: Daya ke arah pusat yang mengekalkan objek bergerak dalam bulatan.

definition.en: Orbits above the equator with a 24-hour period, so it stays above one spot.
definition.bm: Mengorbit di atas khatulistiwa dengan tempoh 24 jam, jadi kekal di atas satu tempat.

definition.en: Minimum speed needed to escape a planet's gravity.
definition.bm: Laju minimum untuk terlepas daripada graviti planet.

question.en: Planet A orbits the Sun at radius r with a period of 1 year. Planet B orbits at 4r. Find the period of planet B.
question.bm: Planet A mengorbit Matahari pada jejari r dengan tempoh 1 tahun. Planet B mengorbit pada 4r. Cari tempoh planet B.

steps.en: Kepler's third law: T² ∝ r³, so T_B²/T_A² = (r_B/r_A)³.
steps.bm: Hukum Kepler ketiga: T² ∝ r³, jadi T_B²/T_A² = (r_B/r_A)³.

prompt.en: The distance between two masses is doubled. The gravitational force becomes…
prompt.bm: Jarak antara dua jisim digandakan. Daya graviti menjadi…

explanation.en: F ∝ 1/r². Doubling r divides F by 2² = 4.
explanation.bm: F ∝ 1/r². Menggandakan r membahagi F dengan 2² = 4.

prompt.en: Find the gravitational force between two 1000 kg masses 2 m apart. (G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²; type e.g. 1.5e-5)
prompt.bm: Cari daya graviti antara dua jisim 1000 kg yang berjarak 2 m. (G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻²; taip cth. 1.5e-5)

explanation.en: F = (6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ × 1000 × 1000) ÷ 2² = 1.67 × 10⁻⁵ N — tiny, which is why we don't feel it between everyday objects.
explanation.bm: F = (6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ × 1000 × 1000) ÷ 2² = 1.67 × 10⁻⁵ N — sangat kecil, sebab itu kita tidak merasainya antara objek harian.

prompt.en: Earth's mass is 5.97 × 10²⁴ kg and radius 6.37 × 10⁶ m. Calculate g at the surface. (G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹)
prompt.bm: Jisim Bumi 5.97 × 10²⁴ kg dan jejari 6.37 × 10⁶ m. Hitung g di permukaan. (G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹)

prompt.en: According to Kepler's first law, planets orbit the Sun in…
prompt.bm: Menurut hukum Kepler pertama, planet mengorbit Matahari dalam…

options.en: ellipses with the Sun at one focus
options.bm: elips dengan Matahari di satu fokus

explanation.en: Orbits are ellipses with the Sun at one focus (most are nearly circular).
explanation.bm: Orbit ialah elips dengan Matahari di satu fokus (kebanyakannya hampir bulat).

prompt.en: Kepler's second law tells us a planet moves fastest when it is…
prompt.bm: Hukum Kepler kedua memberitahu planet bergerak paling laju apabila ia…

options.en: at any point — speed is constant

explanation.en: Equal areas are swept in equal times, so near the Sun the planet must cover a longer arc in the same time.
explanation.bm: Luas sama disapu dalam masa sama, jadi dekat Matahari planet perlu melalui lengkok lebih panjang dalam masa sama.

prompt.en: Planet A: orbit radius r, period 1 year. Planet B: orbit radius 4r. Find the period of B in years.
prompt.bm: Planet A: jejari orbit r, tempoh 1 tahun. Planet B: jejari orbit 4r. Cari tempoh B dalam tahun.

prompt.en: Select ALL features of a geostationary satellite.

options.en: Moves in the same direction as Earth's rotation
Passes over the North and South Poles

explanation.en: Polar orbits pass over the poles — used for weather and mapping, not geostationary.
explanation.bm: Orbit kutub melalui kutub — digunakan untuk cuaca dan pemetaan, bukan geopegun.

prompt.en: Why does a satellite in a higher orbit move more slowly?
prompt.bm: Mengapa satelit dalam orbit lebih tinggi bergerak lebih perlahan?

options.en: v = √(GM/r), so larger r gives smaller v
options.bm: v = √(GM/r), jadi r lebih besar memberi v lebih kecil

options.en: There is more air resistance higher up
options.bm: Rintangan udara lebih tinggi di atas
Graviti lebih kuat di tempat tinggi

explanation.en: Gravity is weaker further away, so less centripetal force is available and the orbital speed is lower.
explanation.bm: Graviti lebih lemah apabila jauh, jadi daya memusat lebih kecil dan laju orbit lebih rendah.

prompt.en: The escape velocity from Earth's surface is about…
prompt.bm: Halaju lepas dari permukaan Bumi ialah kira-kira…

explanation.en: v = √(2GM/R) ≈ 11.2 km s⁻¹. 7.9 km s⁻¹ is the speed of a low orbit.
explanation.bm: v = √(2GM/R) ≈ 11.2 km s⁻¹. 7.9 km s⁻¹ ialah laju orbit rendah.

prompt.en: G in F = Gm₁m₂/r² is called the universal ______ constant.
prompt.bm: G dalam F = Gm₁m₂/r² dipanggil pemalar ______ semesta.

explanation.en: G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻², the same everywhere in the universe.
explanation.bm: G = 6.67 × 10⁻¹¹ N m² kg⁻², sama di seluruh alam semesta.
